It describes a welcoming atmosphere and a varied cuisine that has something for every taste and includes regional products, among other things. The cosy interior and an attentive service team are meant to ensure a thoroughly enjoyable culinary experience. The Imst region in the Tyrolean Oberland is known for its alpine landscape, its traditional inn culture and dishes made with local ingredients.
